title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 36
paragraphs: Let what has been said of the Hyperboreans suffice. For the tale of Abaris, who is reported to have been a Hyperborean, I do not tell—namely how he carried the arrow about all over the earth, eating no food. If, however, there really are Hyperboreans, it follows there are also Hypernotians; and I laugh when I see that, though many before this have drawn maps of the earth, no one has set the matter forth intelligently. They draw Ocean flowing around the earth, which is circular exactly as if drawn with compasses, and they make Asia equal in size to Europe. In a few words I shall state the size of each division and what its outline is like.
